Items marked RECALL were not re-verified this session and carry MEDIUM/LOW confidence; no contract numbers or dollar values were invented - where a value was not surfaced it is omitted. OTHER NAMES SURFACED BUT NOT WRITTEN UP (second tier or off-scope): PeopleTec (Huntsville AL, established contractor; $300K 2nd place xTech AI Grand Challenge 2025); Beast Code (Fort Walton Beach FL software/digital-twin firm; SpaceWERX 2025 STRATFI, relevance LOW); Albedo (VLEO EO imagery; STRATFI 2025; S03); CesiumAstro (phased-array comms hardware; STRATFI 2025; S05 hardware); Gravitics and Castelion (STRATFI 2025; not C4ISR); xTechPacific 2025 winners FieldLine Industries (subsurface hazard detection), Havoc and ZeroMark (maritime autonomous platforms) - not core C4ISR software; Infleqtion $2M Army assured-PNT ML contract (2025-12-11) is master-list. RECALL candidates worth a follow-up agent if budget allows: Forterra (ground autonomy; appears already covered by batch B04 files in scratchpad), Overland AI (ground autonomy, DARPA RACER), Scientific Systems Co. (collaborative autonomy, AFRL Phase III), Toyon Research (sensor fusion/tracking SBIRs), Charles River Analytics and Aptima (serial C2 decision-support SBIR performers - classic proto-purgatory exemplars), Mattermost (DDIL collaboration on Platform One), Rancher Government Solutions (edge Kubernetes), Hypori (Army BYOD/zero trust), Virtualitics (AFWERX STRATFI analytics), Anchore (Iron Bank scanning), Deepwave Digital and Bastille Networks (spectrum sensing), Slingshot Aerospace (space C2/SDA). CONTEXT: AFWERX lists 'Command, Control & Battle Management' among FY26 priorities and AFWERX/SpaceWERX reopened SBIR/STTR solicitations following reauthorization (https://www.dvidshub.net/news/564491/afwerx-spacewerx-open-new-sbir-sttr-solicitations-following-reauthorization); Army SBIR keeps a standing 'Generative AI Enabled Tactical Network' topic (https://armysbir.army.mil/topics/generative-ai-enabled-tactical-network/). STUDY IMPLICATION (INFERENCE, MEDIUM): the prize/SBIR funnel is producing many data-pipeline and edge-AI performers but the observable transitions in 2025-2026 (Rune, Rise8 STRATFI, NGC2 vendors) favor venture-backed, product-shaped companies that attach to a named program (NGC2, Dynamis, Warp Core) rather than SBIR-only firms; a two-founder team should treat SBIR as validation/non-dilutive runway, not as the go-to-market. FOUNDER CONSTRAINTS: SBIR/STTR eligibility requires a U.S.-based small business majority-owned by U.S. citizens or permanent residents (and xTech prize eligibility has similar rules); the Indonesian founder's ownership share and any ITAR/export-controlled technical data access need specialist legal review - no legal judgment is made here.
